common_state: All three are ordinary buff instances in the existing shared lifecycle; no character-specific activation path.

dmg_scale_mag_pct.reference: Nonempty target_effect identifies a damage-effect name.
dmg_scale_mag_pct.scope: Same caster as damage; active instances multiply factors.
dmg_scale_mag_pct.snapshot: Immediate damage at execution; deferred B3 bonus stores magnitude at cast, before later cast buffs and expiry.
dmg_scale_mag_pct.reference_condition_model: The upstream damage callback checks caster/name/expiry without rechecking target or live conditions.

atk_buff_mag_pct.scope: Recipient must be in modifier targets; modifier source owner need not match carrier owner.
atk_buff_mag_pct.aggregation: Add modifier percentages, multiply source base ATK contribution.
atk_buff_mag_pct.reference_condition_model: The upstream ATK magnitude loop does not recheck modifier live conditions.

received_dmg_buff_mag_pct.reference: Named received_dmg_pct carrier on the enemy.
received_dmg_buff_mag_pct.scope: Both carrier and modifier must target that enemy and pass live conditions.
received_dmg_buff_mag_pct.aggregation: Append base-value times magnitude increments, preserving modifier-major/base-minor order.

evidence_policy: These are explicit reference models with independent arithmetic witnesses. No blanket in-game correctness claim. Correct models when stronger game evidence contradicts them.
independent_witnesses: Received damage 55.5 -> 40.5; distinct owners and unrelated targets/names
Skill damage 1875 then cumulative 3375; multiplicative factors with wrong owner/name ignored
integration_witnesses: Deferred B3 bonus: early magnitude expires before full burst; later cast magnitude must not apply
Complete raw Brady and Emma Tactical Upgrade squads, including reordered positions
compiler_gate: Missing/empty/non-string target_effect rejected. Forged modifier reference and actor fields are validated before GPU execution.
remaining: Eve additionally needs named skill-hit notifications. Other missing effects remain explicit rejections; the all-character goal is incomplete.
